data.narrative:
Unconventional AI is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Naveen Rao, Michael Carbin, Sara Achour, and MeeLan Lee that has raised $475M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector contains 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched.

Stage-progression analysis, the only applicable triangulation method, uses the $475M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed to next-stage advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis could not be applied: while 12 same-sector companies exist, none met minimum thresholds (need ≥3 datapoints) when filtered for same or adjacent stage and similar valuation tier. Public-comp anchoring, though the Semiconductors sector median trades at 21.0x price-to-sales across the three public tickers, cannot be executed without the target's revenue disclosure—standard for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B to $1.4B, centered on $1.2B. This estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of sufficiently comparable private peers at this stage and scale. Revenue visibility and commercialization milestones will be critical to validating or revising this range at future funding events.
